content.title: About
content.content: Frozen Mocha Coffee Drink is a refreshing cold beverage that blends aromatic espresso, rich chocolate syrup, and creamy milk. Served as a frozen cocktail, often topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa powder.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink combines coffee and chocolate flavors, making it popular among dessert‑coffee lovers.
The frozen version lets you enjoy coffee in hot weather without the heat.
Cold espresso is usually used to prevent flavor dilution during freezing.
Some recipes add ice cream or protein powder for a thicker texture.
Frozen Mocha is often served in glass cups with a straw, garnished with chocolate shavings.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Both coffee and cocoa contain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Espresso provides a quick energy lift thanks to caffeine.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Caffeine and theobromine in chocolate can improve mood and alertness.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D (when made with milk)
items.content: Dairy components supply calcium and vitamin D, important for bone health.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: A frozen drink encourages fluid intake during warm weather.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: High caffeine intake may cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup and added sweeteners increase calories and can affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: If made with cow's milk, people with lactose intolerance should use alternatives.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Rare, but possible allergic reactions to coffee components.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the Frozen Mocha Coffee Drink immediately after preparation while it remains cold and slightly slushy. Top with whipped cream, sprinkle cocoa powder, or add chocolate shavings. For extra creaminess, stir in a scoop of ice cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared drink in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. For longer storage, freeze it in an airtight container, noting that the texture may change after thawing.
